nsb_quizmaster.text: Croeso to the No Sign Bar, Wind Street. Dylan Thomas put this place in one of his stories. He didn't put the prices in, thank God.
Quiz night. Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Fair play. Hwyl, and watch the step.

then.text: (At the piano, practising.) Organ Morgan, at your service. Music, music, all day long, even in my sleep.
Bach first thing, Bach last thing. Mrs Organ Morgan would like a word about that.

else.text: You found the voice of Organ Morgan for the Dylan Thomas Centre.
(Muttering lines under their breath.) Sorry, love. Rehearsing. There's a reading at the Dylan Thomas Centre and I've got about four words.
